column1: # Referenced-path exemptions for bootstrap/check-unit-drift.sh's REFERENCED-PATH
# check. Format: unit<TAB>relpath<TAB>evidence. Keyed on the EXACT unit+path
# pair, never on the unit alone -- a whole-unit exemption would silently
# license any future dangling reference added to that template under the
# original, unrelated justification (round-2 review defect 2, proven in
# check-unit-drift.test.ts: appending an unrelated ExecStartPost path to an
# already-exempted unit must NOT ride in on its pre-existing evidence).
# Absence with no entry here is a failure (Hard Floor 7) -- a path only lands
# here with a named reason, not by default.
# AN ENTRY EXPIRES (V3-2.16). The day this repository carries the path, the
# reason the entry was granted for is gone, so a row naming a path that now
# EXISTS is itself a failure (PATH-EXEMPT-STALE), reported by name with the
# line to delete. This ledger used to excuse bpa-meteorite.service for
# /meteorite/run.sh through the whole of the row that built it (V3-1.5, landed
# 133541c) -- harmless, and proof that it could not tell a live debt from a
# discharged one. It is the same rule instance/doc-path-exemptions.tsv has
# carried since V3-2.13, deliberately not a second design.
# THE EVIDENCE COLUMN STARTS WITH AN OWNER: `owner=<id>; <reason>`. The id is a
# workboard row or a decision ledger row -- whoever will close the debt -- or
# the literal `none` when the entry deliberately needs no row, in which case
# the reason after the `;` states why. Two rows here recorded "no workboard row
# yet" and stayed that way, which is how an unowned debt behaves; the parser
# now refuses an entry without the field. The FIELD is generic mechanism, the
# id FORMAT is this installation's (CLAUDE.md Mission, HR-309), so
# bootstrap/check-unit-drift.sh matches the field and never a row-id shape.
# Ported unit templates point at scripts from v2-deprecated's layout. Some
# name mechanisms not yet built on v3 (tracked as their own workboard rows);
# others name a specific product's deployment paths, which HR-309 already
# rules belongs under instance/, not the generic mechanism directory -- see
# instance/units/ and instance/expected-units.tsv for that move. Both classes
# are real gaps, not silently patched over.
